overview: P0 E2E validation that all major surfaces use deterministic error banner semantics: code, message, trace id, retry gating, and support escalation/fallback behavior.
goals: Ensure retry appears only when safe/retryable.
Guarantee support escalation carries safe context.
successMetrics: All tested surfaces render consistent ErrorBanner schema.
Support configured/unconfigured branches both remain usable.

routes.name: Detail Surface
routes.purpose: Quick Start, chat, artefact error flows

uiNotes: ErrorBanner always displays deterministic `code` and message.
Retry button appears only for retryable errors with retry handler.
Support CTA uses configured target; fallback guidance appears when missing.

importFormat.description: Scenario triggers representative errors across export, quick start, and chat surfaces.

rules: Retry semantics are controlled solely by `retryable` flag.
Support context includes safe identifiers only.

stories.title: Render Deterministic Error UX Across Surfaces
stories.description: As an operator, I need every surface to expose the same error/retry/support contract so recovery is predictable.
acceptanceCriteria: Given representative failures are triggered on export, quick start, and chat, each renders ErrorBanner with deterministic code/message.
When error is retryable, Retry CTA appears and replays action safely.
Then support action includes safe context (`code`, `trace_id`, `route`) via configured channel.
Example: non-retryable validation error hides Retry but keeps support action/fallback guidance.
Negative: when support target is absent, UI shows fallback support guidance instead of broken link.
